decisive_items: microcephaly, marked enlargement of both lateral ventricles without signs of elevated intracranial pressure, and severe thinning of the frontal, parietal, and occipital lobes
mild optic nerve pallor with suspected peripapillary double-ring sign
response.rationale: Core brain malformation (microcephaly, ventriculomegaly without pressure, cortical thinning) points to cerebral dysgenesis; ocular findings are secondary optic nerve involvement, not primary retinal disease.

rejected.why: No joint contractures or other akinesia stigmata; twin demise is nonspecific.
Ocular findings are present but brain imaging shows a primary cortical malformation, not isolated retinal disease.
Low birth weight is consistent but the structural brain anomaly is the defining feature, not growth restriction.
Ventriculomegaly occurs without elevated intracranial pressure, arguing against true hydrocephalus.
